description: This file defines a Drupal Views field plugin class 'Roles' that provides a list of user roles, including methods for initialization, querying, pre-render processing, and token handling.

classes.name: Roles
classes.description: A Drupal Views field plugin class that displays a list of roles associated with users.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the database connection for the Roles plugin.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the field, adding the 'uid' as an additional field.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds the database query to fetch user roles.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares role data for each user before rendering.

methods.name: render_item
methods.description: Returns the role name for display.

methods.name: documentSelfTokens
methods.description: Defines tokens for role name and machine name.

methods.name: addSelfTokens
methods.description: Adds role tokens for a specific item.
